text: When you need healthcare, but don't know where to go or how much it will cost.
By law, every hospital publishes their prices, but they make it unreadable for people.
Upfront reads them for you. Say what happened. Pine's agent works out how a hospital would bill it.
It may ask some clarifying questions, like how you plan to pay.
One answer. UCSF, about three thousand dollars.
And every hospital nearby. The same broken arm. Three thousand here. Seven thousand there.
The price changes with your plan, too.
Some hospitals hide the file. Pine's agent goes to the website, finds it, downloads it.
Every number is a published price. Now you can see it before you go.
